punchline: In Pink's argument a tax return can be prepared abroad or by software, but understanding the client is harder to ship.
thirty_sec: Daniel Pink says three forces, Abundance, Asia and Automation, are changing which skills pay. Rule-based work can be done more cheaply abroad or by software, and with so much to buy, design and meaning matter more. He adds that left brain and right brain is a simplified metaphor for two styles of thinking.
